blocks.text: Dutch letters have their own names. You need them every day to spell your name, your address or an e-mail address: Hoe schrijf je dat? (How do you spell that?). Most letter names are simply the sound of the letter with a vowel.

U is a sound English doesn't have: say 'ee' with round lips

blocks.title: Spelling your name
blocks.text: Hoe heet je? — Emma. Hoe schrijf je dat? — E, M, M, A. In e-mail addresses: @ = apenstaartje (little monkey's tail), . = punt, - = streepje.

Dutch has short and long vowels, and the difference changes the meaning: man (man) and maan (moon). A long vowel is written with two letters in a closed syllable (maan), but with one letter at the end of a syllable (ma-nen, the moons).

blocks.title: The spelling rule: one letter or two?
blocks.text: When a syllable ends in a vowel (an open syllable), one letter is enough for a long vowel: maan → ma-nen, boom → bo-men. A short vowel needs a closed syllable, so the consonant doubles: man → man-nen, bus → bus-sen. This rule explains most Dutch spelling.

head: Sound
Examples
How to make it
rows: a rough sound at the back of the throat, like Scottish loch; g and ch sound the same
start with the 'ow' of house and round your lips; there is no English sound like it
say the 'e' of her with tight, round lips
between 'ay' and 'eye'; ij and ei sound exactly the same
s + the throat sound: s-ch-ool, not 'skool'

blocks.title: v, z and w
blocks.text: At the start of a word, v and z sound softer than in English, almost like f and s: vader, zon. The w is made with the lower lip against the upper teeth, softer than an English w: water, wat. And at the end of a word, d sounds like t: hond sounds like 'hont'.

blocks.title: Units first, then tens, in one word
blocks.text: Dutch says the units first, like the old English four-and-twenty: eenentwintig (21 = one-and-twenty), vijfendertig (35), negenennegentig (99). It is written as one word, with en (and) in the middle. When two vowels would clash, a trema shows the new syllable: tweeëntwintig, drieëntwintig.

blocks.title: veertig and tachtig
blocks.text: Two tens are spelt differently from their unit: vier → veertig (40) and acht → tachtig (80). And dertien, dertig come from drie but are written with der.
